## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, change and practical limits.

## Validation

List commands actually run, results and the tested commit. Label scripted, mock-transport, synthetic or live evaluation explicitly.

## Design considerations

Explain relevant effects on model authority, source provenance, verification, review, spending, recovery or compatibility. Link updated documentation when behavior changes.

## Repository workflow

Target `main` from a short-lived work branch. Use a conventional PR title, keep the scope focused, and wait for the required CI checks before squash merging. See [BRANCHING.md](https://github.com/Akhilesh-Vangala/verifyops/blob/main/BRANCHING.md).
